title: See an AI assistant run a PK analysis
summary: Watch an AI assistant run a full population PK analysis using the NLME MCP Server, connecting Claude Code and other AI tools to Certara's Phoenix NLME engine.
body_markdown:
ShareShareShare


Get a quick look at the Modelling Assistant, Certara’s connector between AI coding tools and the Phoenix NLME engine. This short video gives a glimpse of an AI assistant working through a population PK analysis, so you can see the idea before diving into the details. Contact us for a full demo.


### View transcript


Pharmacometricians already live in R. What if their AI agent could too? That is the RSNLM E MCP server at work. Not a generic coding assistant guessing its way through R. It is a purpose built agent, wired directly into RSNLM E and the NLM E engine that powers Phoenix.


Hand it a dataset, and it fits the model, runs the goodness of fit checks, and hands back a reproducible R script. No code required from you.


Ask a follow-up and it returns the PML with final parameter estimates, ready to reopen in Model Designer.


Or go further. One prompt, a full population PK analysis, exploratory analysis, base model development, stepwise covariate search, visual predictive checks, all the way to a regulatory ready report, and a QC package your colleagues can rerun and reproduce exactly.


On demand webinar


## Model Smarter, Not Harder: Introducing Model Designer


If you work in R and NLME today, the RsNLME MCP server is designed to bring this seamless integration straight to your workflow.


[Learn more in our webinar](https://www.certara.com/on-demand-webinar/model-smarter-not-harder-introducing-model-designer/)
